newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products - fuel, gas oil ease, mogas stead.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products - fuel, gas oil ease, mogas stead.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday.
High sulphur fuel oil was weaker, but quiet. Low sulphur fuel oil fell by around $3 a tonne.
Naphtha cargoes ended steady to higher, buoyed by a rebound in crude and continued prompt supply tightness.
Gasoline edged slightly up on the back of crude and gasoline futures but trading was quiet.
Gas oil premiums lost about $1-2 a tonne to March IPE +$6 with the market concerned about what was likely to happen to the 558,500 tonnes delivered against the expired Feb contract.
